newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares rally at close, may gain more.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares rally at close, may gain more.

text.p: Singapore shares recovered from midday losses at the close on Thursday with some dealers still looking for possible gains before the weekend.
"The market rallied in the last hour or so and put on a spurt just before the close," said one dealer. "I think we could see better numbers tomorrow on the back of some foreign buying."
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials share Index ended 2.81 points higher at 2,067.17 after dipping to a low of 2,055.68. Total market volume was thin at 100.9 million shares.
Cycle & Carriage and Singapore Press each rose 10 cents to Singapore $14.50 and S$12.40 respectively.
Several Singapore stocks with prominent Indonesian investors jumped sharply in late afternoon trade.

Dealers said the rise might be related to Thursday's general election in Indonesia since all the companies affected had been linked with supporters of the ruling Golkar party, which was certain to be re-elected.

Infrastructure company L&M Group rose 18 cents, or 13 percent, to Singapore $1.55, while United Pulp & Paper was up 17 cents, or 14 percent, at S$1.35. Ice-cream company ABR Holdings rose 14 cents, or 13 percent, to S$1.18.
